description: Arm (enabled: true) or disarm (enabled: false) auto-merge on one PR: it merges by itself through the full gated merge chain (CI, required checks, branch protection, CODEOWNERS, risk) once CI and every required check are green and no reviewer with write access has changes requested. Stays armed while anything is pending; `last_attempt.reason` says what it waits for. Arming is also the merge train's consent: on a repository with the train on, the train merges only armed PRs, so disarming holds the PR from it (an explicit gluecron_merge_pr still merges). Requires write access and 'repo' scope. merge_method: 'merge' only. Returns {number, auto_merge}.

merge_method.description: 'merge' (default; the only method the gated chain has)

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_set_auto_merge
